steps.content: The unexpected intrusion briefly stuns the room into silence, though it doesn't take long before whispers begin to rise again.

steps.speaker: Distinguished Guest
steps.content: Who's this kid?
Ignoring the bewildered gazes fixed on her, Lemma leads the way to the podium and calmly takes up the microphone Lambert had left behind.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: The anomaly you just witnessed was caused by sudden fluctuations in the simulated Mania force field. This kind of thing was rare in early testing, but now that BR-005 has erupted and global catastrophes are intensifying, anomalies like this will only become more frequent. We do need to address it.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: That said, this technical model was designed with considerable adaptive capacity from the start. Adjust a few parameter sets, add environmental sampling and analysis stages, and it can handle Level 3 Mania fluctuations with ease. That covers all conventional scenarios.

She flips open her terminal and keys in more than a dozen lines of impossibly complex formulas, her fingers flying so fast you can barely follow. The commands are locked in before you can process anything, and her explanation comes in streams of terminology that sail straight past comprehension.

The simulation battlefield resets in an instant. The nodes stay where they were, but the system now responds with razor-sharp sensitivity to Summer's covert modifications, swift and exacting. In what feels like seconds, a flawless sweep is completed.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: It's fine if you didn't follow that. You're not scientists. You came to see a show, and you've seen enough. The recordings and materials are all prepared. Take them back and run them by your technical advisors.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: If they can't produce a clear explanation within two days, I suggest you let them go and blacklist every institution that endorsed them while you're at it. They don't belong in this field.

The terminal snaps shut in her hands, serving as a quiet, final punctuation. The crowd blinks back to awareness. Whether they understood a single word doesn't matter; that sheer display of dominance in itself demands recognition. Enthusiastic applause erupts for the prodigy.

steps.speaker: Distinguished Guest
steps.content: I-I see. Truly worthy of the Director's star pupil. Now this is the standard the Ring Research Institute ought to uphold.

steps.speaker: Distinguished Guest
steps.content: Did you rush over here to present on Professor Isomer's behalf?

A shadow passes over Lemma Herzfeld's expression. She draws breath to speak, but a sharp clap rings out. The tall girl next to her has brought her hands together, and every eye in the room snaps toward her.

steps.speaker: Enya
steps.content: That concludes our portion. We'll leave the remainder to Professor Lambert. I'm confident that by now he has a thorough grasp of the material and can field any questions you may have. Please follow him to the conference room next door.
The audience seems unwilling to disperse. However, the staff she summoned continue to file in, growing in number until the majority have no choice but to fall in line and shuffle out.
The old professor approaches them. After an embarrassed word of thanks for saving him from that predicament, he parts his lips to speak, his voice unsteady.

steps.speaker: Lambert
steps.content: ...Did Isomer send you? Does she... does she have anything to say about... my situation?
Lemma's eyes flick to Lambert, then slide away in silence. It's the boy nearby who gently takes the old man by the arm and leads him aside for a quiet word.

steps.speaker: Barrie
steps.content: Shh—Lemma's not really in the best mood lately. Probably best not to bring all this up with her. Just leave it to us. We won't say a word about today to Isomer, alright? Don't you worry, Mr. Lambert. Go home and get some rest.
His words offer a measure of comfort.

steps.speaker: Barrie
steps.content: And maybe... talk it over with your family. Think about retiring a bit early, you know? My grandpa always used to say that once you get up there in years, the mind just can't keep up the way it used to. I imagine that's been happening with you too, Professor? Don't push yourself too hard.

steps.speaker: Lambert
steps.content: I—
Just like that, the old man is abandoned. He is prodded forward, guided out, his gaze empty and unfocused as he vanishes through the exit.
Lemma, meanwhile, makes her way directly to you both, or more accurately, to Summer. She plants herself squarely before her.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: The great "genius scientist" actually came back to sit through one of Lambert's garbage presentations. You really do have a gift for wasting your own time, Summer.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: All those years out there, and you never once came back. Was it because you knew you had nothing to show for it? Too embarrassed to show your face?

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Nothing to show for it?!
Summer springs to her feet.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: That just shows how out of the loop you are! I've already completed my greatest masterpiece: <color=#fb9259>The Age of Youth</color> anime trilogy, wrapped and perfect! It's incredible! MBCC still has the master copies. I'll do free screenings for everyone!

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Just hearing about it makes my blood boil. To think you'd neglect real work to this degree...I'm surprised you haven't packed up and moved into your little fictional world already.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Wait, that's an option?! Does this mean your Black Ring blah-blah-spatial-dimension-blah-blah-Mania-transition project that's been stalled for ten thousand years finally made a breakthrough? Congratulations, Lemma! Hurry up already, I can't wait to hop over to another world!
The blonde girl's eyelid twitches faintly.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Ooh, your eye twitched again. Don't tell me...

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Oh, right! Those results at the symposium just now weren't exactly groundbreaking. Surely we didn't get stuck again, did we? What's the holdup this time?
Lemma tilts her head back. They're practically the same height, yet with the impressions she's giving off right now, she's unmistakably gazing down at Summer.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: We're progressing on our own timeline. A deserter like you hardly has the standing to offer critique.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Okay, but "deserter" does sound preeeetty cool. Thing is, before I left, I accidentally cleared out the whole task queue. Including the stuff that's not mine. What about you?

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Team leader?
Lemma lets the taunt go unanswered. Then another voice, barely above a whisper, speaks up and draws this ridiculous conversation to a definitive close.

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.content: Don't get so full of yourself. I remember perfectly well how you slunk away in disgrace five years ago.

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.content: Have you forgotten what you came crying to me for back then?
Summer wilts before your eyes, every ounce of her earlier spark extinguished.
Lemma takes it in, her stare sharpening with contempt.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: ...The projects from five years ago are basically elementary school homework compared to what we're doing now. I can't believe you're still stuck back there. Pathetic as ever, I see.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: You deserve to be left in the dust.
Without so much as a flicker of hesitation, you step up and position yourself as a barrier before the now-drooping Summer.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Does winning a schoolyard shoving match like this actually make you proud? Kicking someone who's already down?
Only then does Lemma spare you a first glance, but her gaze quickly slides away.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Did security all take the day off? How did some clueless outsider wander in here?

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: The Ring Research Institute is a serious academic institution. It brings together the brightest minds and the most advanced research. A scientist's time is valuable. Every word spoken here should be a meeting of intellects, not wasted on someone who wouldn't understand it anyway.
Oh, a scientist? You clear your throat. Time to really make your presence heard.

steps.speaker: Option
options: I'm the one bankrolling Summer's anime project.
I'm the MBCC Chief. That makes us colleagues.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Your institute doesn't seem all that picky about clueless outsiders, though. If anything, you threw a high-profile symposium just to welcome them. Even had top-tier talent like yourself come down personally to play host.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If you asked me, I'd even say you guys are actually quite fond of these scientifically-ignorant people. So, how about simply extending that exact same courtesy right here to me?
She glares at you, visibly stung by the remark.
But you didn't come here to pick on a child. While the little prodigy is still fumbling for a comeback, you take the opportunity to cut straight to what matters.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I need to see Isomer. She's your advisor, isn't she?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm here on business. And if we're going to talk business, I'd say speaking with the Director herself would be far more productive.
Something in your words must have hit its mark. Lemma's expression ices over in an instant.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Don't try pulling rank on me. Unlike Lambert, I'm an actual research lead. I have full responsibility for my project, my team, and complete autonomy over every decision.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: I don't take orders from that woman.
Well, well, well. So there's some friction there. Better push it just a little further, then.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Oh? Your project? Impressive. What field, exactly? I have a hard time picturing the Ring Research Institute handing anything critical over to a bunch of kids.
She freezes, her eyes darting to you. Though she holds her mouth shut with every ounce of willpower she can muster, her expression, clearly unversed in hiding things, betrays her.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: ...If you're so concerned about BR-003, MBCC Chief, then maybe you should be back at your post hunting down the Undergrounders who are threatening to take it. Where exactly do you find the time to indulge some pink-haired brat and her dress-up delusions?
So she does recognize you, and she's aware of what concerns you. A student of Isomer's, perhaps?
In any case, it seems luck's on your side. Had it been Isomer who was here, it's hard to say whether you could pry loose even a single useful word. This girl, however, makes for the perfect wedge.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Well, since you already know who I am, that simplifies things. BR-003 is high on my priority list as well. You handle the research, we handle security. Sounds to me like the Ring Research Institute and MBCC ought to be on the same side.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: On top of that, I do have some insight into how the enemy operates. Wouldn't it make sense to compare notes in the field?

steps.speaker: Option
options: Consider it an "exchange" between the two people in charge.

steps.content: You gaze down at her. This angle offers a clear view of her blonde crown, and you make a point of tilting your chin up a fraction more.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Unless you think this grown-up's being too mean. In which case, we can drop it. I'll take this up with your "real" supervisor instead.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: ...Fine. Bring it on.

Summer exchanges a glance with the three kids across the way. They're almost synchronized as they make their choice: Summer darts to your side, the others to Lemma's. Two opposing forces now stand here, poised and ready.
Lemma's fingers are already hovering over the keys.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: I'm not some washed-up hack like Lambert. This time, you won't have any room to cheat.
